text:
alex: Quick idea — let's reduce manual steps during change windows by extending deploy bot with a tiny macro system and release-note templates. Brainstorm?

Taylor: love it. Two small flags to add: `--pin=<version>` and `--hold-window=YYYY-MM-DDT09:00/11:00Z` for change windows. Also a `--dry-run` that outputs the rollout plan.

Sam: adding a template generator would help. propose: `rwd-deploy template release-notes --from-commits --include-checklist`

Sam: example template:
```
Release: {{version}}
Change window: {{window}}
Summary: short bullet
Rollout steps:
  - apply manifest
  - smoke tests
  - monitor (10m)
Rollback plan:
  - revert to {{previous_version}}
  - notify #incidents
Acceptance checks:
  - error-rate < 1%
  - latency median < 200ms
```

deploy-bot: current commands: `deploy start`, `deploy rollback`, `deploy status`, `deploy pin`. New features queued: can accept metadata, but needs UX for confirmations. Usage example:
```
deploy start --service catalog --pin v1.2.3 --template release-2026-03 --change-window 2026-03-22T09:00/10:00Z --dry-run
```

Mike: we should also add `--escalation-contact` and `--slo-check` so the bot can auto-flag and optionally auto-rollback if thresholds cross. keep defaults conservative.

Ashley: +1. Also need a tiny checklist macro so release notes include the checklist and link to runbooks. suggest `--embed-checklist runbook-id`

alex: OK plan: (1) small API for templates (yaml/json), (2) bot flags `--pin`, `--hold-window`, `--dry-run`, `--escalation`, `--embed-checklist`, (3) a default rollback policy `auto`/`manual` toggle. Who can own a quick prototype? target: 1 sprint.

Taylor: I'll take prototype for `--pin`/`--dry-run` and the change-window parsing. Will open RFC PR today.

Sam: I'll draft template schema + generator. expect PR by EOD.

Mike: I'll add tests for SLO checks and an integration harness for `deploy-bot` dry-run output.

Ashley: I'll write two example release-note templates (core services, infra) and tie to console copy.

alex: Great. @deploy-bot can we have it post a confirmation message with a :thumbsup: reaction flow when `--dry-run` passes so leads can approve quickly?

deploy-bot: noted — adding `confirm_flow` option to roadmap. Thanks all :shipit:
